Enjoying Free Places Near You

For anyone who wants more to do without spending more. Each day is one small way to discover and enjoy the free places around you, from libraries and parks to community centers, free museum hours, trails and town events.

Wellbeing · Self-Care · Loneliness · one to-do a day · you choose how many days

Start this challenge free

The first seven days

  • Day 1Look up the hours of your nearest public library and write them somewhere you will see them often.
  • Day 2Open a map and find the park closest to your home, then say its name out loud.
  • Day 3Picture a mural, statue or painted wall you pass often, and spend one quiet minute recalling its colors from memory.
  • Day 4Wave hello to a neighbor at a shared spot near home, like a mailbox, a bus stop or a corner bench.
  • Day 5Glance at a community bulletin board the next time you pass one, at a library, grocery store or town hall.
  • Day 6Peek at the display case near your library's entrance on your next visit, and see what is on show.
  • Day 7Walk to a green space within a few blocks of home and sit for five minutes.

Further into the year

The to-dos keep changing as the year goes on. A few from later in this theme:

  • Day 30Call ahead to ask about ramps, elevators, parking or quiet hours before visiting a new free place.
  • Day 60Ask a coworker which free spots they love near work, and add their best idea to your list.
  • Day 120Say yes to a small free invitation from a friend or neighbor this season.
  • Day 240Decide on a simple plan for a winter free outing: where, when, what to wear and how long to stay.
  • Day 365Decide on one free place to make a regular part of your life, and choose when you will next return.

How a challenge works

A Theraglee challenge is a theme with one small to-do for every day of a year. You choose how long yours runs, anywhere from a week to the full year, and each day you get the next to-do: something that takes a few minutes and fits inside an ordinary day. Tick it off when it is done. Nothing is scored and nothing is lost if you miss a day; the next to-do is simply waiting when you come back.

Challenges come with a free Theraglee account, which never asks for a card. Your progress stays private to you.
